resolved_conflicts.explanation: Most sources give 1924 for the log cabin. WillhiteWeb.com photo captions date work to 1925 and 1926, and a packer's recollection on Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1927 or 1928. The story gives 1924 as the usual date and reports the other dates.
Idaho Fire Lookouts and WillhiteWeb.com give 1962 (WillhiteWeb.com also allows the late 1950s); firelookout.com gives the late 1950s. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Brief checked: Shoshone County, Coeur d'Alene NF, L-4, 30 ft (9.1 m) and gone all match the sources. Construction date conflicts (1924 vs 1925-28) are unresolved; no Forest Service primary record was found. Staffing is only the two 1927 names, each tagged (Diary); the diaries themselves were not read. The 1927-28 packer recollection is Ken Maryott's, per the Idaho Fire Lookouts page. No photos added. Access level 'public' rests on the drive-up description and WillhiteWeb.com's 'should be open' remark; no closure reported.
